name: Captain Isfandyar Shaheed
overview: The nation always comes first. For Captain Isfandyar, patriotism was more than just a word. It was a way of life. He faced every challenge with courage, every threat with determination, and every sacrifice with pride. His journey serves as a powerful reminder of what it truly means to serve the nation.
